title: Webb County Treasurer Shares Thanksgiving Message of Gratitude
excerpt: Webb County Treasurer Raul Lorenzo Reyes shared a Thanksgiving message of gratitude, thanking the community for its love, kindness, trust and support, and remembering families celebrating with an empty chair at the table.
content:
Webb County Treasurer Raul Lorenzo Reyes shared a Thanksgiving message of gratitude for Webb County families on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, Thanksgiving Day.

Reyes said Thanksgiving is a chance to pause, reflect, and give thanks for the many blessings in life, and that the greatest treasures are not material things, but the love of family, the friendship of those who stand beside us, and the chance to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others.

He said this Thanksgiving is especially meaningful as he reflects on the blessings, challenges, and lessons of the year, and he remembered those celebrating with an empty chair at the table, saying he hopes the memories of loved ones bring comfort to their hearts.

Reyes said he is deeply grateful to the community for the love, kindness, trust, and support shown to him through the years, and that serving Webb County has been one of the greatest blessings of his life. He wished everyone a beautiful Thanksgiving filled with love, peace, good health, and countless blessings, closing: from my family to yours.
